name: Tidegap — carbon-aware deferral
description: Auto-defer "do it later" tasks to the cleanest electricity-grid hour inside the deadline.

dbPath.description: Override the SQLite queue path. Defaults to ~/.tidegap/queue.db (shared with the @tidegap/mcp server and @tidegap/cli).

defaultRegion.description: Default electricity-grid region when a tool call omits one. Examples: GB, US-CAL-CISO, US-TEX-ERCO, US-NE-ISNE, US-MIDA-PJM, FR, DE. Precedence: the tool call's region, then this field, then the region setting stored on this machine (`tidegap region set <zone>` or Settings → Grid region; key TIDEGAP_DEFAULT_REGION in ~/.tidegap/config, re-read on each call), then a guess from the host machine's time zone (London→GB, Paris→FR, Berlin→DE, US Pacific→US-CAL-CISO, US Eastern→US-MIDA-PJM), then GB. Leave unset to follow the stored setting. (Replaces the TIDEGAP_DEFAULT_REGION environment variable (EBB_DEFAULT_REGION before 0.18), which still configures the tidegap CLI and @tidegap/mcp server.)

electricityMapsApiKey.description: Electricity Maps free-tier API key, used for every grid zone without a more specific feed. Replaces the TIDEGAP_ELECTRICITY_MAPS_API_KEY environment variable (EBB_ELECTRICITY_MAPS_API_KEY before 0.18) — the plugin reads no environment variables. Accepts the ${TIDEGAP_ELECTRICITY_MAPS_API_KEY} secret shorthand. Unset ⇒ those zones fall back to synthetic (mock) grid data.

eiaApiKey.description: US EIA v2 Open Data API key, used for the major US ISO/RTO zones. Replaces the TIDEGAP_EIA_API_KEY environment variable (EBB_EIA_API_KEY before 0.18). Accepts the ${TIDEGAP_EIA_API_KEY} secret shorthand. Unset ⇒ US zones fall back to synthetic (mock) grid data.

entsoeSecurityToken.description: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform security token, used for the EU bidding zones (FR, DE, ES, IT, NL). Replaces the TIDEGAP_ENTSOE_SECURITY_TOKEN environment variable (EBB_ENTSOE_SECURITY_TOKEN before 0.18). Accepts the ${TIDEGAP_ENTSOE_SECURITY_TOKEN} secret shorthand. Unset ⇒ EU zones fall back to synthetic (mock) grid data.

wattTimeUsername.description: WattTime account username. With wattTimePassword, enables WattTime marginal (MOER) forecasts for the US ISO/RTO zones, taking precedence over the EIA feed. Replaces the WATTTIME_USERNAME environment variable. Accepts the ${WATTTIME_USERNAME} secret shorthand.

wattTimePassword.description: WattTime account password. Required together with wattTimeUsername. Replaces the WATTTIME_PASSWORD environment variable. Accepts the ${WATTTIME_PASSWORD} secret shorthand.

anthropicApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for dispatching scheduled tasks directly. Replaces the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable. Accepts the ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY} secret shorthand. Usually unnecessary: when a tool call has captured the OpenClaw runtime LLM bridge, tasks dispatch through the gateway's own model with no key at all.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for dispatching scheduled tasks directly. Replaces the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. Accepts the ${OPENAI_API_KEY} secret shorthand. Usually unnecessary — see anthropicApiKey.

geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key. Gemini is not a gateway-bridge provider, so this (or googleApiKey) is the only way to dispatch gemini-* tasks. Replaces the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable. Accepts the ${GEMINI_API_KEY} secret shorthand.

googleApiKey.description: Fallback Google API key, used for Gemini when geminiApiKey is unset. Replaces the GOOGLE_API_KEY environment variable. Accepts the ${GOOGLE_API_KEY} secret shorthand.

ollamaHost.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server, e.g. http://localhost:11434. Setting it is the explicit opt-in that registers the (keyless) Ollama adapter. Replaces the OLLAMA_HOST environment variable.

ollamaModels.description: Comma-separated Ollama model ids (e.g. "llama3.1,mistral") that should infer to the ollama provider when a task names them without an explicit provider. Replaces the OLLAMA_MODELS environment variable.

carbonBudgetG.description: Aggregate carbon budget in grams CO2e. Crossing it fires a one-shot alert through the configured delivery channel. Replaces the TIDEGAP_CARBON_BUDGET_G environment variable (EBB_CARBON_BUDGET_G before 0.18). Takes precedence over the same key in the ~/.tidegap/config file, which is still read.

carbonBudgetWindow.description: Rolling window the carbon budget is scoped to. Defaults to daily. Replaces the TIDEGAP_CARBON_BUDGET_WINDOW environment variable (EBB_CARBON_BUDGET_WINDOW before 0.18).

deliveryStorePath.description: Override the SQLite file holding per-task delivery preferences and outcomes. Defaults to ~/.tidegap/delivery.db. Replaces the EBB_DELIVERY_FILE environment variable.

disableStartupDispatch.description: Disable the background dispatch loop that drains due tasks every 60s. Replaces EBB_DISABLE_STARTUP_DISPATCH=1. Only for embedding contexts that drive dispatch by hand — with this on, scheduled tasks never run until a tool call triggers them.

disableOsNotifications.description: Never post a desktop notification for the os delivery mode; the result stays in the queue and the outcome records why. The plugin's counterpart of the TIDEGAP_NO_NOTIFY=1 environment variable that the tidegap CLI reads.
